Chapter 500: Chapter 6 Sensation (Please Subscribe)

“Chikun, you’ve taken on a good disciple,”

White Light Star Master said, looking at Chikun Star Lord.

In the universe’s human civilization, it was not uncommon for a disciple to surpass his teacher.

In the different species, there might exist repression and enslavement of a clan’s geniuses.

This would result in the strong remaining strong, and those in high positions, in order to consolidate their own status, limiting the promotional channels of those below them.

But such a phenomenon was almost non-existent in human civilization.

...

Under the governance of the three ultimate intelligent goddesses, as long as you could demonstrate talent in some area, you would be protected.

Even if you had no talents at all, you could still live a stable and secure life,

as long as you did not violate the laws, there wouldn’t be any problems.

Thus, even though the average individual in human civilization might be considered weak compared to other peak clans, it could continuously and steadily produce a large number of strong individuals.

Furthermore, they swept across the eight directions of the universe, and even when facing peak clans like the Insect Race, they could hold their ground and even gain the upper hand.

“Indeed,”

“Having a too excellent disciple is trouble for the teacher as well,”

Chikun Star Lord sighed, causing White Light Star Master to roll his eyes.

At Chikun Star Lord’s level, it was difficult to advance further in a short time, and the usual comparisons with many friends often revolved around their own disciples.

The more outstanding Lin Yuan was, the more glorious Chikun Star Lord, the teacher, felt.

Can you teach a disciple as formidable as mine?

Even if it wasn’t my teaching, it was still my discerning eye that recognized his potential.

Ever since he took on Lin Yuan, Chikun Star Lord had been very comfortable, and he never lost in comparisons with his friends.

Especially just now, having heard from White Light Star Master about Lin Yuan’s formidable combat achievements, Chikun Star Lord felt even more complacent, confident that even if his friends stepped into the Ninth Rank in the future, he would still have them thoroughly outmatched in the realm of taking on disciples.

“What are you smirking about, old man?”

White Light Star Master glanced at Chikun Star Lord.

“Don’t end up still stuck at Eighth Rank while your disciple advances to Ninth,”

White Light Star Master joked.

As Ninth Rank evolvers begin to merge with the Great Universe, even if White Light Star Master found Lin Yuan’s demonstrated combat power incredible, he was sure that Lin Yuan was still at the Eighth Rank.

“I would love to.”

Chikun Star Lord didn’t mind at all.

…

The battle outside the Milky Way Main Star, as time passed, spread like a hurricane through the human territories.

The human territories were vast and expansive, and even the matters of Ninth Rank or Tenth Rank evolvers didn’t necessarily spread widely, few could traverse star domains.

But Lin Yuan’s battle with those five Eighth Rank invincible aliens, having killed two of the Eight Rank invincibles, caused a tremendous shock throughout human civilization.

No matter which star domain it was, there definitely were Eighth Rank invincibles.

And as an Eighth Rank invincible, they were keenly aware of the difficulty in killing another Eighth Rank invincible of the same level.

This was about killing.

Not defeating or suppressing.

“Little Junior Brother…” In another Fringe Starfield, the Red Kun Lineage’s Great Peak Master looked at the information in front of him, somewhat stunned.

He had long known about his Little Junior Brother’s terrifying talents,

who had just stepped into Eighth Rank and could uncontestedly suppress him—an evolver who had adapted to the Eighth Rank for some time.

Even the teacher, Chikun Star Lord, once said Lin Yuan did it while “holding back significantly.”

From that moment on, the Great Peak Master knew that the gap between himself and his Little Junior Brother would only grow wider.

But the Great Peak Master hadn’t anticipated that in such a short time, while he was still striving to balance the many forces within his star domain,

his Little Junior Brother had been ruthlessly dominating among the Eighth Rank invincibles.

…

“Shisan Peak Master, he killed two Eighth Rank invincibles?”

In the Wanyang Star Domain, Wanyang Holy Son let out a sigh upon learning this information.

“Back then I wanted to challenge Shisan Peak Master, now it seems, utterly ridiculous,”

While Wanyang Holy Son was shocked by Lin Yuan’s method of killing Eighth Rank invincibles, he once took Shisan Peak Master as a target for pursuit.

Having a deep understanding of Shisan Peak Master’s growth speed, others might not be able to break the myth of the Eighth Rank invincibles’ invincibility, but Shisan Peak Master did, and Wanyang Holy Son quickly accepted it.

“I never thought I once competed with Shisan Peak Master in the arena…” Wanyang Holy Son felt calm, with a hint of pride emerging.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, his consciousness descending into his inner world.

“Tai Micro Clear Crystal…”

Dozens of star-sized Tai Micro Clear Crystals, accumulated in a region of his inner world, spreading a pure energy aura.

“The expansion begins.”

Lin Yuan thought and released the repression of his inner world.

In an instant, hundreds of thousands of tons of Tai Micro Clear Crystal shattered, turning into pure energy, merging into the inner world, supporting its frantic expansion.

“First, expand the inner world to the limit, then absorb the liquid from the Mysterious Gourd to increase the base multiplier,”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, this was also the most extensive method of savings.

Ending his half-month time traversal, Lin Yuan didn’t directly start absorbing the liquid from the Mysterious Gourd, waiting instead for the arrival of the Tai Micro Clear Crystals.

If he had absorbed the liquid from the Mysterious Gourd first, raising the base multiplier of his inner world to thirteen times, then the energy required to expand his inner world to the size of his understanding of Space Rules afterward would far exceed the current amount.

Increasing from one to three will consume two, but increasing from ten to thirty will consume twenty.

At that time, the Cosmic Crystals Lin Yuan would need to consume would not be eighty thousand, but eight hundred thousand, possibly even exceeding a million.

“According to the current speed of expansion, in five to six days it could expand to 3.75 million miles, then after absorbing the liquid from the Mysterious Gourd, in at most half a month, I could completely recover to nearly a billion miles of inner world…”
